dataset: Seattle SDOT Traffic Study Flow Counts 2023 FLOWMAP sample
license: City of Seattle open data terms; official item states no representation or warranty as to accuracy
preparation_steps: Queried the official Seattle SDOT Traffic Study Flow Counts Feature Service for three 2023 records with FLOWMAP = 'Y'.
Preserved official EPSG:2926 point coordinates from the ArcGIS response.
Mapped STUDY_ID into station_id, STUDY_ADT into count, and retained source record fields in the prepared CSV.
Matched the prepared points against deterministic fixture edges that pass through the official point coordinates.
geographic_scope: Seattle SDOT 2023 FLOWMAP three-record public sample
boundary_note: Official traffic-count intake and edge-match quality on a bounded public Seattle SDOT sample only; not traffic-flow validity, congestion calibration, or production map matching.
